overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation on either allegation and resolved the complaint by informal action. Meeting time was not a notice defect, and the hearing-access issue was referred to the Town's ADA coordinator.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board held meetings at a time other than its customary meeting time.
allegations.key_passage: The complainant's allegation that the Board held meetings at a time other than its customary meeting time, even if true, does not constitute a violation of the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged Board members did not speak loudly enough to accommodate her hearing disability.
allegations.key_passage: Barring a showing that the Board and the Town have refused a reasonable accommodation of the complainant's disability, we find no violation of the Law at this time.
